title: Rx compiler testcase manifest, version 1
description: An array of testcase entries, each with exactly one source file. Runtime input and expected output are paired inside io.

path.description: File path relative to the directory containing this manifest. Both .rx and .rs sources are supported.

input.description: Stdin file for this execution. Null means empty stdin.

output.description: Expected stdout file for this execution. Use an empty file if the program prints nothing.

source.description: Exactly one source file for this testcase. Put additional sources in separate testcase objects.

compilation_success.description: Whether this source must be accepted through the selected stage. False requires normal rejection, not a crash or timeout.

io.description: Paired runtime fixtures. Required for codegen and optimization cases, which must compile successfully. Optional and unused for lex, parse, and semantic.

description.description: Optional test purpose or reason for expected rejection.

metadata.description: Optional authoring information, such as existing lexer snapshots or upstream provenance. Not used for grading.
